emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CA: Santa Clarita city, Oxnard city, Glendale city, Simi Valley city, and East Los Angeles CDP and 8 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
